blocks.text: Who is a candidate for Male Chin Liposuction?

Men with excess fat beneath the chin or along the jawline who are looking for a more defined facial profile may be good candidates. Ideal candidates are in good overall health and have good skin elasticity.Many men consider a tummy tuck after significant weight loss or when skin laxity prevents the midsection from looking toned and athletic. In some cases, a Male Tummy Tuck may also be combined with liposuction for more comprehensive body contouring results.

sections.heading: Ready to take the next step?

blocks.text: Please reach us at info@tampabaybodysculpting.com if you cannot find an answer to your question.
Results are typically long-lasting as long as a stable weight is maintained. Once the fat cells are removed, they do not return.
Incisions used for chin liposuction are very small and are typically placed in discreet areas to minimize visible scarring.

Most patients experience mild swelling and bruising for the first several days after surgery. Many return to light daily activities within a few days, with continued improvement over the following weeks.
